title: ischaemum siamense
intro: Ischaemum siamense, commonly known as Thai grass or Siam wassail, is a species of grass in the family Poaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial effects. The therapeutic actions of Ischaemum siamense include anti-diabetic, anti-ulcer, and wound-healing properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and alkaloids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
